newsitem.title: SPAIN: Asturiana sees 1997 5.0 bln ptas net attributablea profit.
newsitem.headline: Asturiana sees 1997 5.0 bln ptas net attributablea profit.

text.p: Spain's Asturiana de Zinc said on Tuesday it expected to swing to a profit in 1997 and post net attributable profit of 5.0 billion pesetas assuming that zinc prices remained between $1,050 and $1,030 per tonne.
"We are optimistic for 1997...We foresee consolidated net profit of around 5.0 billion pesetas based on a zinc price of between $1,050 and $1,030," Asturiana Chairman Rafael Benjumea told reporters.
The company said it expected a rebound in 1997 due to better zinc prices and because it has cleared its large zinc position.
"We could see a higher profit if the average zinc price for the year remains higher than $1,050," Benjumea said.
The company said if zinc prices remained at current levels of around $1,230 it would make a net attributable profit of 13.39 billion pesetas.
Asturiana liquidated its remaining loss-making zinc futures position on the London Metals Exchange during 1996. The company said the position reached a high of 800,000 tonnes at the end of 1993.
